title: external_refs
description: A projection of NESC external_refs rows. entity_key derivation: App\Models\Job -> job_number (covers p2 / jobmaster / p2_runner / pmo / sphere refs, worker_activity presence AND the "assignment:<id>" booking refs, which MirrorProjector::waBooking writes on the Job); App\Models\JobTask -> external_task_id, else synthetic_key, else the row is omitted; Pole (candidate_key) and Inspection (nesc:inspection:<id>:r<rev>) are RESERVED — no projector writes them in 1b and the PMO side must not expect them. entity_id is informational (NESC primary key). Emitted only when the ExternalRefDriftCheck passes. Key: entity_type|entity_key|system|external_id. Delta.

entity_id.description: Informational: the NESC primary key; never a join key across apps.

system.description: p2 | jobmaster | p2_runner | worker_activity | pmo | sphere | smartsheet.

properties.description: The JSON column is `properties` (Phase 1c deviation), not `attributes`.

scope.description: Stamped by the builder from the manifest scope when the emitter did not set it; absent => UNSCOPED.

origin.description: Phase 1e: set to "smartsheet" on sheet-origin rows; absent on app-origin rows.

origin_ref.description: Phase 1e: {sheet, row, column, modifiedAt}; the receiver applies idempotently by origin_ref and never re-exports.
